deployment_blocker.message: Live deployment is blocked because the owner repository has been locked for write operations.
deployment_blocker.details: The current user does not have sufficient permissions to push changes to the target branch due to repository protection rules or lock status.

manual_enablement_instructions.step_1: Navigate to the GitHub repository settings.
manual_enablement_instructions.step_2: Go to the 'Settings' tab and select 'Pages' from the left sidebar.
manual_enablement_instructions.step_3: Ensure the source is set to 'Deploy from a branch' (usually main or gh-pages).
manual_enablement_instructions.step_4: If locked, unlock the repository by changing the protection rules or removing the lock status in 'Settings > Actions > General > Workflow permissions'.
manual_enablement_instructions.step_5: Commit the sanitized feed logic changes to trigger a new build.
manual_enablement_instructions.note: Ensure your local environment is synchronized before pushing.
